truncate_string_with_ellipsis: truncate a string to a max line length using ellipsis for long lines
truncate_multiline_string: truncate a multiline string to a max number of lines with ellipsis on overflow
truncate_lines_from_list: truncate a list of lines to a max line length and max number of lines
truncate_tail_lines: truncate a string keeping only the last N lines instead of the first N lines
review_truncate_function: review the truncate function to understand how it handles max_line_len and max_lines parameters
